title: A Supernova Constraint on F-theory
summary: We study constraints on the quantum chromodynamics (QCD) axion in F-theory, a strongly coupled limit of string theory. We build models of QCD from compactifications to four dimensions on elliptic fibrations over toric threefolds $B_3$, characterized by an integer $N=h^{1,1}(B_3)$. The QCD axion mass increases with $N$, and we find that models with sufficiently high $N$ are inconsistent with observations of the neutrino burst from supernova 1987A, disfavoring large regions of the moduli space.
